$comment: Generated by pnpm features:sync from packages/features/src/registry.ts. Constrains config.deployment, config.features and config.administratorRecovery.

mode.description: Only processed with the recovery feature on. Check is read-only; apply grants access.

expectedMembers.description: Optional active team roster count; mismatch refuses without recovery writes.

organization.description: Organization ID or exact slug; optional only for one organization.

team.description: Designated non-SCIM Admin team ID or exact name.

teams.description: Alternative organization ID or slug to team ID or name map.

deployment.description: Which product this install is. Only OpenWork Cloud sets "cloud". Renders DEN_DEPLOYMENT.

mcpOAuthDomainRecovery.description: MCP OAuth domain recovery: Reconnect external MCP connections after the deployment public domain changes without recreating the connection. Renders DEN_FEATURE_MCP_OAUTH_DOMAIN_RECOVERY.

webPerMember.description: OpenWork Web per member: Admins choose which members get OpenWork Web from the Members page, and the organization pays for Web only for them. Members without it can't open a Web computer. Off: every member and pending invitation has Web and is billed for it. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WEB_PER_MEMBER.

googleCalendarRecurrence.description: Google Calendar recurring meetings: Create and change recurring meeting series through the native Google Calendar capabilities. Renders DEN_FEATURE_GOOGLE_CALENDAR_RECURRENCE.

googleDrivePdfText.description: Google Drive PDF text: Agents read the text of PDFs in Google Drive, up to 50 MB, instead of being told the file is too large. Renders DEN_FEATURE_GOOGLE_DRIVE_PDF_TEXT.

autoRouter.description: AI Gateway: Smart Model Router: Admins create Smart Routers for everyone, teams or people, listing AI Gateway models and the tasks each handles. Members pick "Smart: <name>": each prompt goes to the model whose tasks fit it best, at the thinking level it needs. Renders DEN_FEATURE_AUTO_ROUTER.

gatewayCustomProviders.description: AI Gateway: custom OpenAI-compatible providers: Admins add any OpenAI-compatible provider to AI Gateway with a name, an API URL and one key, pick its models (fetched from the provider and matched to models.dev), test one, then save and edit it later. Renders DEN_FEATURE_GATEWAY_CUSTOM_PROVIDERS.

plainFreeModel.description: Desktop: OpenWork Free listed like any other model: The free model shows in the model picker under its own name (GPT-6 Luna) with the same row as every other model, stays selectable when its usage limit is used up, and the limit message appears in the chat after sending. Renders DEN_FEATURE_PLAIN_FREE_MODEL.

settledSessions.description: Desktop: settle finished sessions: Finished sessions can be settled into a collapsed Settled row at the end of their workspace, by hand or after a few idle days, and come back on new activity. Renders DEN_FEATURE_SETTLED_SESSIONS.

appToolRepair.description: Apps: fix a changed tool with an agent: When a connected tool an App uses changes at its provider, so OpenWork blocks the App's call to it, the App's managers see a Fix with agent button in Artifacts that starts a conversation to update the App. Renders DEN_FEATURE_APP_TOOL_REPAIR.

composerBackgroundTasks.description: Desktop: background tasks on the composer: Commands the agent leaves running in the background are listed on top of the composer, under the Agents list, with how long each has run, instead of a count in the chat. Renders DEN_FEATURE_COMPOSER_BACKGROUND_TASKS.

agentQuestions.description: Desktop: agents ask and keep working: Agents ask in chat instead of ending a turn to wait for your reply. A question that the rest of the work does not depend on stays open while the agent keeps going, and your answer reaches it even after its turn has ended. Renders DEN_FEATURE_AGENT_QUESTIONS.

steadyLiveTurn.description: Desktop: steady chat while a reply runs: While a reply runs, its steps and messages stay in the order they arrive and the chat keeps its place: nothing jumps and no empty gap opens between steps. The steps fold into “Worked for…” once the reply finishes. Turning this off restores the previous live layout. Renders DEN_FEATURE_STEADY_LIVE_TURN.

ssoPerOrganization.description: SSO: optional unless required, enforced per organization: An organization with SSO set up offers "Continue with SSO" at sign-in but still lets people on its domain use their password or Google and join other organizations, for example from an invitation. Turning on "Require SSO" enforces it when someone opens that organization, and "Restrict this domain to our SSO" brings back sign-in-wide enforcement for the whole domain. Off: any email on the organization's verified domain must sign in with its SSO. Renders DEN_FEATURE_SSO_PER_ORGANIZATION.

ssoSettingsOnSsoPage.description: SSO: sign-in requirement on the SSO page: The "Require SSO" and "Restrict this domain to our SSO" settings move from Org settings to the top of the SSO page, next to the SSO connection they depend on. Off: they stay in Org settings under Authentication. Renders DEN_FEATURE_SSO_SETTINGS_ON_SSO_PAGE.

multipleSsoConnections.description: SSO: several connections per organization: An organization can set up more than one SSO connection: several identity providers, and each one covering one or more email domains. Each connection is verified, tested and turned on by itself, and sign-in shows one button per identity provider. Off: the SSO page manages a single connection. Renders DEN_FEATURE_MULTIPLE_SSO_CONNECTIONS.

featureIntros.description: Den: feature intros: Den pages, sub-pages and tabs explain themselves while nothing is set up: a full-screen intro, info box or banner with one action that leads straight to setup, a quiet dot on tabs not viewed yet, and a ? button to reopen the intro. Turning it off restores the previous empty states. Renders DEN_FEATURE_FEATURE_INTROS.

authSecuritySettings.description: Den: Auth & Security settings: Settings shows one Auth & Security page with Single sign-on (SSO) and User provisioning (SCIM) tabs instead of separate SSO and SCIM pages; old SSO and SCIM links open the matching tab. Turning it off restores the separate pages. Renders DEN_FEATURE_AUTH_SECURITY_SETTINGS.

sessionSecuritySettings.description: Den: session length, maximum session length and admin re-authentication settings: Auth & Security gets a General tab where admins choose how long sign-ins last without activity (12 hours to 7 days), how long they last at most however active (1 to 90 days, 30 by default), on the web and in the desktop app, and how recently an admin must have signed in before sensitive changes (15 minutes by default, up to 1 day, or never). Needs Auth & Security settings on. Off: sessions last 7 days without activity with no maximum, and sensitive changes ask admins to sign in again after 2 hours. Renders DEN_FEATURE_SESSION_SECURITY_SETTINGS.

administratorRecovery.description: Deploy-time administrator recovery: Run a one-time, operator-selected Admin-team permission repair at deployment; disabling stops future repairs, not existing grants. Renders DEN_FEATURE_ADMINISTRATOR_RECOVERY.

superAdminPermissionSet.description: Super admin permission set: Super admins get their permissions from an editable Super admin role, seeded with every permission, beside Member and Admin. Off: super admins hold every permission and the role is hidden. Renders DEN_FEATURE_SUPER_ADMIN_PERMISSION_SET.

nativeDictation.description: Native dictation: Dictate editable prompts in OpenWork and Workbot using native desktop dictation or live browser speech recognition. Renders DEN_FEATURE_NATIVE_DICTATION.

connectionMcpServers.description: Connect: an MCP server for each connection: Members can add one connected service, such as Gmail or Linear, to an agent like Claude Code as its own MCP server that lists only that service's tools. Renders DEN_FEATURE_CONNECTION_MCP_SERVERS.

desktopPersonalConnectors.description: Desktop: members add their own connectors: Members can add a custom MCP server from the desktop app's Library and sign in with their own account, the same way they can from My Library on the web. Without it, the desktop only lets owners and admins finish connector setup. Renders DEN_FEATURE_DESKTOP_PERSONAL_CONNECTORS.

opencodeV2Only.description: OpenCode v2 only: Desktop chats always run on OpenCode v2: switching to OpenCode v1 is turned off and earlier chats are copied to v2 in the background. Renders DEN_FEATURE_OPENCODE_V2_ONLY.

managedDeployments.description: Managed deployments: Organization admins install OpenWork in their own AWS account or Google Cloud project and see its health and updates in OpenWork, and agents connected to OpenWork can create and follow those deployments. Renders DEN_FEATURE_MANAGED_DEPLOYMENTS.

workbotDocuments.description: Workbot Documents: Members browse recent Google Drive files and folders in Workbot, open documents in tabs, and save supported text and spreadsheet edits to Drive. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_DOCUMENTS.

workbotDocumentEditing.description: Workbot Documents: editing: Members choose Edit from a document preview. Full Office editing starts their Cloud workspace only when requested. Requires Workbot Documents. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_DOCUMENT_EDITING.

workbotWorkspaceAssistant.description: Workbot: workspace assistant: Members ask Workbot about the document they have open (Ask Workbot brings it into the chat) and navigate from a compact sidebar. Workbot offers to open the documents it mentions. The chat itself stays on its own page. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_WORKSPACE_ASSISTANT.

workbotDriveFiles.description: Workbot: reading Drive files: Workbot reads PDFs, Office files and large files from Google Drive or OneDrive on its computer instead of saying they are too large. When it has no computer (and in Slack) it says plainly when a file is too large and asks the person to send the file instead. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_DRIVE_FILES.

workbotAccountMenu.description: Workbot: account menu: The avatar in Workbot's header opens a menu with the signed-in account and workspace, Switch workspace, Your dashboard and Sign out, instead of only linking to the dashboard. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_ACCOUNT_MENU.

workbotBrowserChat.description: Workbot: chat beside the browser: On wide screens, Workbot's Browser and Computer views keep the conversation docked beside the live page, with the open tab shared as context, so people can direct browser-heavy work without switching back to Home. Narrow screens use the floating chat. Needs browser use. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_BROWSER_CHAT.

workbotInstantOpen.description: Workbot: chats open instantly: Workbot keeps the newest messages of each chat on the person's device and shows them the moment a chat opens, while it reads the conversation again. Nothing is kept while a reply is being written; kept messages are cleared on sign-out and after a week. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_INSTANT_OPEN.

workbotScrollToBottom.description: Workbot: scroll to latest messages: People reading earlier messages keep their place while Workbot replies, with a button to return to the latest messages. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_SCROLL_TO_BOTTOM.

workbotBrowserRecovery.description: Workbot: browser recovery: Retries a read once when a loading page changes, reconnects a lost browser connection, and tells Workbot when a consent dialog or human-verification check is in the way. Never repeats clicks, typing or submissions. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_BROWSER_RECOVERY.

workbotQuickReply.description: Workbot: quick human acknowledgment: Workbot answers work requests with a concise acknowledgment before discovery, reactions or browser work. Accepted explicit long requests can show a temporary receipt while waiting for the first model words. Does not promise a response-time SLA. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_QUICK_REPLY.

workbotWorkingStatus.description: Workbot: working status and task sheet: While Workbot works, a quiet status line under its name says what it is doing; tapping the name opens a task sheet with its steps and each background task's steps. The chat keeps only what Workbot says: no typing dots during work, no computer or task cards unless Workbot is showing its screen. Its first reply stands on its own instead of "give me a sec", and it can say how a background task is going. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_WORKING_STATUS.

workbotCenteredProfile.description: Workbot: centred avatar and profile: A centred OpenWork avatar with Workbot's name and live status in a pill; tapping opens tasks, permissions, computer, schedules and identity. Requires the profile sheet and working status. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_CENTERED_PROFILE.

workbotBrowserPreview.description: Workbot: inline browser preview: Live browser/computer work offers a passive thumbnail and one Open browser button in the reply, reusing its last real frame while reconnecting. Never automatically opens the full view. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_BROWSER_PREVIEW.

workbotProfileSheet.description: Workbot: profile: Tapping Workbot's name opens its profile: what it is working on and its background tasks, what it can use (connected apps, browser, computer, files) with a link to manage connections, and what it remembers about the person, read-only. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_PROFILE_SHEET.

workbotRemoteTasks.description: Workbot: remote tasks: Shows recent tasks started on another computer in Workbot's profile and working status, from stored create receipts and member-authorized live status. De-duplicates pure status watchers by explicit task ids; never approves or stops remote work automatically. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_REMOTE_TASKS.

workbotProactive.description: Workbot: Your agent: Every member gets a read-only background agent that checks Gmail and Google Calendar each morning and about every three working hours, sending a short Workbot Slack DM only when needed. Members review checks and messages in My bot, tell it what they care about, narrow its hours and limits, undo changes, snooze or mute it. Admins choose its responsibilities and see aggregate 7-day health in Manage › Workbot, without member names or content. It never sends email, accepts invitations or edits data for them. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_PROACTIVE.

workbotAgentBrief.description: Workbot: Your agent's brief and check rhythm: With Your agent on, it checks on one rhythm (every 2 hours in working hours by default, plus up to 3 extra checks it asks for) instead of four fixed message types, and follows a plain-text brief: the organization's default plus each member's own lines, set in Manage › Workbot, My bot or chat. Each check researches first and then writes at most a few short messages, each one finding with a lock-screen first sentence. Messages per day and hours stay hard limits. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_AGENT_BRIEF.

workbotSlackAnswerReply.description: Workbot: Slack answers as their own reply: In Slack, Workbot's notes while it works ("Let me check your calendar.") stay in one message that updates in place, and its final answer is posted as a new reply that notifies the person, written in its own words. Replaces the fixed "Done:" ping that quoted the first line of the reply. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_SLACK_ANSWER_REPLY.

browserUploadPermissions.description: Browser: managed and remembered file-sharing permissions: Admins set Allow, Ask first or Block for browser uploads, with website exceptions. Members can remember permission for one website and a folder on this computer across chats and Slack-started tasks, and revoke it in Settings. Renders DEN_FEATURE_BROWSER_UPLOAD_PERMISSIONS.

agentHarnessPermissions.description: Agent permissions: computer use, app scripting and outside folders: Admins choose Allow, Ask first or Block for computer use, Mac app scripting and folders outside the workspace on the Agents tab, and members' desktop apps apply them. Renders DEN_FEATURE_AGENT_HARNESS_PERMISSIONS.

computerUse.description: Computer use: Let agents use Mac apps or a managed cloud desktop with a live view and Take over and Stop controls. On Mac, supported app windows stay in the background without moving your cursor; agents read controls first and take screenshots only when needed. Canvas apps such as Blender still come to the front. Requested apps open without additional OpenWork approval prompts. GUI access is experimental and is not sandboxed by structured-tool permission rules. Renders DEN_FEATURE_COMPUTER_USE.

computerSessionHistory.description: Desktop: computer session history: Computer actions share one compact session card in chat, with captured views to browse or replay. Turning it off restores individual actions and screenshots. Renders DEN_FEATURE_COMPUTER_SESSION_HISTORY.

parallelComputerUse.description: Parallel computer use: On a Mac, agents a chat starts work in their own apps at the same time, as part of that chat: one Stop, Take over and output folder for all of them, a cursor name and color for each, and their windows in view while you watch the chat. Turning it off returns each agent to working on its own. Renders DEN_FEATURE_PARALLEL_COMPUTER_USE.

browserUse.description: Workbot: browser use: Workbot uses the browser on its cloud computer with a live Browser view people can watch and take over. It streams the page only when it changes, with Workbot tabs to switch and close; takeover controls the page without Chrome's toolbar. Needs remote computers. Computer use separately controls other desktop apps. Renders DEN_FEATURE_BROWSER_USE.

browserDemonstrations.description: Workbot: teach browser tasks: Demonstrate a browser task with explanations, save it as a private reusable skill, and run it with new inputs. Renders DEN_FEATURE_BROWSER_DEMONSTRATIONS.

remoteComputers.description: Desktop: computer use on remote computers: Use a Linux cloud computer with its browser and desktop in OpenWork Web, or connect a VM from Desktop. Configured and conversation-owned desktops open directly when enabled, including follow-ups and internal session renewal. Take over and Stop stay available. Renders DEN_FEATURE_REMOTE_COMPUTERS.

remoteSessionPush.description: Desktop: start tasks from other computers right away: A task sent to this person's desktop from another computer, Workbot or an agent starts within a second or two instead of up to a minute later. Den tells the desktop the moment the task is queued over the runner's event stream; the desktop still checks every minute as a fallback. Renders DEN_FEATURE_REMOTE_SESSION_PUSH.

sandboxGateway.description: Workbot: computers through the sandbox gateway: Workbot's cloud computers for this organization run through the runner's sandbox gateway (Differently), which holds the provider keys and picks the provider, instead of the runner's own Freestyle or Daytona account. Needs a runner with SANDBOX_GATEWAY set; without one, or while it is down, new computers use the runner's own provider. Renders DEN_FEATURE_SANDBOX_GATEWAY.

sandboxMicrosoft365.description: Sandboxes: sample Microsoft 365 for Workbot: New sandbox organizations get one Microsoft 365 connector for the sample Outlook, Calendar and Drive instead of three separate ones, so Workbot chat, Calendar, Documents and the first hello read each person's own sample mail, calendar and files. Each person approves once in their own browser. Only sandbox organizations are affected; every other organization keeps Microsoft's real sign-in. Turning it off stops the sample connector without sending anything to Microsoft. Renders DEN_FEATURE_SANDBOX_MICROSOFT365.

connectStandardTools.description: Connect: standard tools: Claude Code and standalone OpenCode discover connected actions, Workflows and Apps as individual tools; OpenWork Desktop, Web and automation runs keep capability search. Capability search uses MCP tool schemas with older fields kept for compatibility. Turning this off restores the previous search view and schemas. Renders DEN_FEATURE_CONNECT_STANDARD_TOOLS.

connectEngineTools.description: Connect: a tool for each action in OpenWork's engine: OpenWork Desktop, Web and automation runs get each connected action, Workflow and App as its own tool, found with their engine's Code Mode search; capability search stays for OpenWork's own operations and skills. Other clients are unaffected. Turning this off restores capability search. Renders DEN_FEATURE_CONNECT_ENGINE_TOOLS.

standardCodeMode.description: Workflows and computer programs as standard JavaScript: Workflows written from now on, Workflow tests, and computer-use programs on the desktop app and cloud computers run as standard JavaScript (ECMAScript, checked against test262), calling tools described the MCP way with JSON Schema. The engine is @opencode/codemode. Workflows saved before keep running as they always have. Turning this off returns new Workflows and computer programs to OpenWork's original Code Mode; Workflows saved as standard JavaScript stop with a message rather than switching interpreter, and run again when it is back on. Renders DEN_FEATURE_STANDARD_CODE_MODE.

outlookAttachments.description: Outlook attachments: Agents read the files attached to Outlook messages and create Outlook drafts and replies with workspace files attached, after the member approves each draft. Drafts are never sent. Renders DEN_FEATURE_OUTLOOK_ATTACHMENTS.
